US Military on High Alert Amidst Regional Tensions

The United States military has been placed on high alert due to escalating tensions in the Middle East, with Iran and its allies reportedly targeting energy supplies. This heightened state of readiness comes amid concerns about the nation's military arsenal and its capacity to respond to potential threats. The situation underscores broader regional instability and its potential impact on global energy security.
